newsitem.title: JORDAN: PSA planning "good surprise" for workers.
newsitem.headline: PSA planning "good surprise" for workers.

text.p: PSA Peugeot Citroen chairman Jacques Calvet said the group was hoping to announce a "good surprise" for its workers shortly.

"I hope...we'll have a good surprise...that will clearly express the solidarity between our personnel and the management," Calvet told reporters during a weekend presentation here of the Peugeot 406 coupe. He gave no clues, but the group is expected to announce its annual wage offer soon.
Late last month its ailing rival Renault announced that it was closing an assembly plant in Belgium and would cut nearly 6,000 jobs in Europe.
Calvet said he sensed workers were worried and praised them for their solidarity and loyalty. "We feel them standing solidly behind us with one idea -- pushing the company forward," he said.
He reiterated that the PSA group had no plans to close any plants.
